newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hundreds of Mexicans trapped by rejected students.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds of Mexicans trapped by rejected students.

text.p: Hundreds of Mexicans were trapped in Cuernavaca's city hall on Wednesday by students who could not register at a local university because of poor grades.
Local news reports said there were 500 trapped city workers and visitors.
A source from the mayor's office who declined to be named said the city hall's doors were shut to protect workers from about 100 "very aggressive" protestors.
The students blocked nearby streets to protest that they were not allowed to take an admission exam for the local university because of poor grades, she said.
The protest disrupted the normally tranquil town, about 25 miles (40 km) south of Mexico City.
